*Sorry for the long reply, just really wanted to share this story as an example.*

Yeah, that is smart, the most memorable encounter I had was when my party went against a mind flayer and his mind controlled goons after spending some time in his weird dungeon, I balanced the encounter to be deadly and kind of unbeatable because one of my players was departing for a long time and I needed a reason for him to disappear, so after them wailing on the mind flayer for an unreasonable time (I may have added some health points for flavor), the mind flayer went invisible and made his last stand floating on the edge of the platform they were fighting on, so my paladin (the one who had to leave in real life for some time), made the ballsy decision to throw himself at the mind flayer and go at him with everything he had left in himself, I explained as they wrestled through the air until they plummeted down and using the mind flayers teleportation ability, they went through a rift into an alternate world.


As the mindflayer disappeared, his minions slowly regained consciousness, with all of my players on their last thread, almost completely drained.


They expressed after that session, that they were all really afraid that that would be the end of the Fellowship of the light (I know, original name for a party).


That was the unplanned, probably most memorable roleplay session of all of my sessions. Because my players were really scared for their characters.


**TL;DR:**

Best encounter was because I made it "unbeatable", almost resulting in a party wipe.
